events.title: Emperor Nero takes his own life
events.description: Declared a public enemy by the Senate, Nero died at a freedman's villa outside Rome. His death ended the Julio-Claudian dynasty and opened the Year of the Four Emperors.
events.html: Declared a public enemy by the Senate, Nero died at a freedman's villa outside Rome. His death ended the Julio-Claudian dynasty and opened the Year of the Four Emperors.

events.title: Abu Muslim launches an open revolt against Umayyad rule
events.description: Abu Muslim, a Persian revolutionary and military commander, began an open revolt against Umayyad rule. The Abbasid revolution brought down the Umayyad Caliphate in 750, and the Abbasid Caliphate that replaced it ruled from Baghdad.

events.title: Duccio's Maestà is installed in Siena Cathedral
events.description: Duccio di Buoninsegna's Maestà, a huge double-sided altarpiece of the Virgin and Child commissioned by the city of Siena in 1308, was carried in procession around the city and installed in Siena Cathedral.
events.html: Duccio di Buoninsegna's Maestà, a huge double-sided altarpiece of the Virgin and Child commissioned by the city of Siena in 1308, was carried in procession around the city and installed in Siena Cathedral.

events.title: Rhode Island colonists burn the British schooner Gaspee
events.description: The British revenue schooner HMS Gaspee, which enforced the Navigation Acts, ran aground off Warwick, Rhode Island, and that night men led by Abraham Whipple and John Brown boarded and burned her. The affair heightened tensions before the American Revolution.

events.title: Congress of Vienna signs its Final Act
events.description: Days before Waterloo, the great powers signed the treaty redrawing Europe's map after Napoleon. Its settlement shaped European borders and diplomacy for decades.
events.html: Days before Waterloo, the great powers signed the treaty redrawing Europe's map after Napoleon. Its settlement shaped European borders and diplomacy for decades.

events.title: Charles Dickens dies at Gad's Hill
events.description: Dickens died at his Kent home aged 58, leaving The Mystery of Edwin Drood unfinished. His novels of poverty and injustice had made him the most popular author of his age.
events.html: Dickens died at his Kent home aged 58, leaving The Mystery of Edwin Drood unfinished. His novels of poverty and injustice had made him the most popular author of his age.

events.title: Donald Duck makes his screen debut
events.description: Donald Duck first appeared in the Disney short The Wise Little Hen. His temper and garbled voice made him one of the studio's most popular characters.
events.html: Donald Duck first appeared in the Disney short The Wise Little Hen. His temper and garbled voice made him one of the studio's most popular characters.

events.title: Secretariat wins the Belmont by 31 lengths
events.description: Secretariat set a world record for the distance and became the first US Triple Crown winner in 25 years. His Belmont time still stands as the race record.
events.html: Secretariat set a world record for the distance and became the first US Triple Crown winner in 25 years. His Belmont time still stands as the race record.
